name: Do I need to be home during the roof replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home during the roof replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not strictly necessary for you to be present on-site throughout the entire roof replacement project, we recommend being available for the initial consultation and to discuss any questions or concerns that may arise. Our team will manage all aspects of the project, ensuring minimal disruption to your daily routine. We prioritize clear communication, so you'll be kept informed of progress and any significant updates. We understand your schedule is important, and we work to accommodate it while maintaining project efficiency and quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't need to be home constantly, but we recommend being available for the initial consultation and to address any questions. We'll keep you updated on progress.
